title: Mon Mayuree
desc: Priyo, a poor orphan, secures a job through his mentor Sunil Da. Meanwhile, he falls for his boss's daughter, but a child calling him father sparks trouble.

title: Ekai Eksho
desc: Ratan, an honest autorickshaw driver, refuses to help a corrupt politician, Pradip Roy, which then leads to a local war. He also ends up falling in love with Jhilik, his daughter.

title: Tarini Tarama
desc: Rajababu prohibits all religious devotion, causing villagers to oppose his oppressive deeds. Jasodha, his spouse, performs sacred worship secretly; ultimately, Rajababu converts to a staunch devotee.

title: Cheetah
desc: Jamal, a gangster, kills Amar's family. To everyone's surprise, the latter survives, wakes from a coma and seeks revenge.

title: Manush Keno Beiman
desc: L Chowdhury, a simple villager, who lives with his sister, finds his life turned upside down because of an unexpected accident.

title: Jatugriha
desc: Madhuri and Shatadal separate due to their inability to conceive, despite Shatadal's love for children. Years later, they reunite, reigniting their unspoken affection.
